jobs.job: Trends-only quick check, capped at 10 minutes: find what is rising on TikTok today for the shop account (trending sounds, hashtags, top videos in the category) and put real, named, dated findings on the run. Do not page the showcase. Bring the one story sentence on a 'Story:' line: who this is for and why they'd care, in Glam's voice, the way she'd say it to a friend. No sentence, no handoff.
needs: the farm's TikTok browser (Glam keeps it signed in) to read today's trends
an AI model (Claude, Muse/Indigo or another assigned agent) to do the writing — the runner itself never writes
sent_back: scout findings on file but the story sentence does not pass — no 'Story:' line in scout.md. The Scout does not hand off without one real sentence in Glam's voice: who this is for and why they'd care (a 'Story:' line in steps/step2-scout/scout.md)

jobs.job: Pick the day's product from this week's lineup (farm-data/weekly-lineup.json). Start with the stock and price check: a sold-out product gets skipped and the next one is picked. Write the pick record with a 'product:' line (exact listing name) and the listing ID or link.
needs: TikTok Shop Streamer Desktop / LIVE Manager (Glam signs it in herself) for the stock and price check on the picked product
sent_back: BLOCKED: the pick 'BASK AND LATHER Scalp Stimulator Hair Growth Oil - Lightweight Rosemary & Mint Blend for Thicker, Fuller Hair, Alopecia Support & Hair Regrowth' is not in the saved showcase list (farm-data/showcase-products.json)

jobs.job: Submit the picked product's real listing photo from its photos saved with the lineup (farm-data/products/<listing id>/). It becomes the only product description for every later step. If its photos weren't saved, the product is BLOCKED with the reason. Never a drawn or substituted photo. A photo comes ONLY from TikTok Shop Streamer Desktop / LIVE Manager, the product's public TikTok Shop listing page (the shop.tiktok.com product page for that listing ID, no sign-in needed), or the image links saved from those (image_urls in farm-data/showcase-products.json, downloaded with no browser and no sign-in), never from a regular tiktok.com video or profile page. Only a product-only image, never one with a person, face, hands or body in it. Any bot or security check: report BLOCKED at once with the site and page, never solve it or wait on it.
needs: the product's real listing photos, saved with the weekly lineup
